title: The Kite That Came Home
logline: When the wind snaps the string of her late grandmother's kite, nine-year-old Amara learns that a neighbourhood is a kind of family.
theme: small kindnesses find their way back

motivations.CHAR-HUM-001: fly Grandma's kite all by herself
motivations.CHAR-HUM-004: keep his late wife's spring tradition alive
motivations.CHAR-HUM-002: cheer his sister up without looking soft
motivations.CHAR-HUM-005: return what the wind brought her

conflict: The kite string snaps and the family heirloom disappears over the rooftops.
ending: The neighbour who found the kite is invited to fly it with them tomorrow.

scenes.heading: EXT. FERNMOOR PARK - DAY
scenes.purpose: Set up the bond between Amara and Grandpa and the heirloom kite.

lines.text: Grandpa! The wind is perfect today!
Then let's wake up Grandma's old dragon kite.

scenes.heading: EXT. FERNMOOR PARK - MOMENTS LATER
scenes.purpose: The loss: the string breaks; her brother turns tears into a plan.

lines.text: No... the string broke. It's gone!
Hey, don't cry. Kites can't fly far without wind.
Come on. We'll find it together.

scenes.heading: EXT. MAPLE STREET - SUNSET
scenes.purpose: The return: the neighbour found it; kindness comes back and the circle grows.

lines.text: Is this little dragon looking for someone?
It landed in my lemon tree.
Good things find their way back to kind hearts.
